Kaiord gathers your training and health data from the platforms where it is scattered. The Kaiord App is the browser application where you plan your week, build workouts, talk to an assistant and send workouts to Garmin Connect. The Kaiord SDK is the TypeScript libraries, CLI and MCP server that read and convert FIT, TCX, ZWO and Garmin Connect workouts.

Your data lives in IndexedDB on your device.
